llm.summary: This is a coherent bug-review workflow skill with no executable payloads, hidden persistence, credential handling, or exfiltration behavior found.

dimensions.detail: The skill's instructions focus on language detection, reproducing bugs, documenting defects, preparing minimal fixes, and verifying tests, which matches its stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger list includes broad terms like bugs, fixes, and verification, so it may activate in more conversations than a narrowly named bug-review skill; the loaded instructions remain scoped to code review and remediation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown skill files only and no executable install scripts; it references an optional upstream plugin and config dependencies but does not auto-install or run them.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Repository reads, test commands, linters, and patch preparation are proportionate for a bug-review workflow and are disclosed in the instructions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No background workers, scheduled tasks, privilege escalation, credential/session access, or persistent local indexing behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this if you want an agent to perform structured bug review and fix planning. Be aware it may trigger on general debugging or verification requests, and its suggested test or lint commands should still be reviewed before running in sensitive repositories.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger concern is partially supported by the trigger list, but the effect is low-impact because the artifacts only provide disclosed bug-review guidance and do not add hidden authority.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, consistent with the Markdown-only artifact contents.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean and is consistent with the lack of executable files, though it was not used as the sole basis for the verdict.
